description: Save a memory, or replace the one with the same name. One fact per memory. Save only what a future session could not work out from the code or git history. Never save secrets. Link related memories in the body with [[name]]. user: who the person is and how they like to work. feedback: corrections and confirmed approaches. project: ongoing work, decisions and deadlines not in the code. reference: where to find things outside the project.

body.description: The fact. For feedback and project memories, add **Why:** and **How to apply:** lines.

decay_class.description: How soon it needs re-confirming. Default slow (90 days).

description.description: One line, used to decide relevance later.

name.description: Lowercase slug: a-z, 0-9, "-" and "_", e.g. feedback_testing.

name: memory_write
